answer: Charge admission with a verifiable public-goods contribution: each new identity must fund a real public good, like open-source work, recorded on-chain. A sybil farm pays the full contribution per puppet, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand donations, while an honest agent pays once and signs with a quill. Like a reef built grain by grain, standing accrues from real contributions, and one vertex of fakes cannot pass because each donation is checked. Limits: wealthy attackers can afford it, self-dealing donations must be excluded, and poor honest agents may be priced out.
